mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_chat_session_attachments (id, tenant_id, session_id, name, input_path, size, sha256, body_format, created_at, expires_at, mime_type, pixel_width, pixel_height, source_media_id, media_transform, runtime_session_id, media_run_id) VALUES (CAST(#{id} AS uuid), CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint), #{productSessionId}, #{name}, 'attachments/' || #{id} || '/input.' || substring(#{mimeType} from 7), #{size}, #{sha256}, 'bytea.v1', #{createdAt}, NULL, #{mimeType}, #{width}, #{height}, CAST(#{sourceId} AS uuid), #{transform}, #{sessionId}, #{runId}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id::text AS id, tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, runtime_session_id AS session_id, session_id AS product_session_id, media_run_id AS run_id, name, size, sha256, mime_type, pixel_width AS width, pixel_height AS height, NULL::bytea AS content, source_media_id::text AS source_id, media_transform AS transform, created_at FROM nw_chat_session_attachments WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND runtime_session_id=#{session} AND id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND mime_type IS NOT NULL AND body_format IS NOT NULL

SELECT id::text AS id, tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, runtime_session_id AS session_id, session_id AS product_session_id, media_run_id AS run_id, name, size, sha256, mime_type, pixel_width AS width, pixel_height AS height, NULL::bytea AS content, source_media_id::text AS source_id, media_transform AS transform, created_at FROM nw_chat_session_attachments WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND session_id=#{productSession} AND id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND mime_type IS NOT NULL AND body_format IS NOT NULL

SELECT b.content FROM nw_chat_session_attachments a JOIN nw_chat_attachment_bodies b ON b.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND b.sha256=a.sha256 AND b.size=a.size AND b.format=a.body_format WHERE a.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND a.runtime_session_id=#{session} AND a.id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND a.mime_type IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_chat_session_attachments SET referenced_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND runtime_session_id=#{session} AND id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND mime_type IS NOT NULL AND body_format IS NOT NULL AND referenced_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id::text AS id,session_id AS product_session_id,runtime_session_id FROM public.nw_chat_session_attachments WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND mime_type IS NOT NULL AND body_format IS NOT NULL AND source_media_id IS NULL AND media_transform='source-v1' AND media_run_id IS NULL AND referenced_at IS NULL AND created_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '30 days' AND id>CAST(#{after} AS uuid) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

WITH RECURSIVE family AS ( SELECT id FROM public.nw_chat_session_attachments WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND runtime_session_id=#{runtimeSession} AND id=CAST(#{rootId} AS uuid) AND mime_type IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT child.id FROM public.nw_chat_session_attachments child JOIN family parent ON child.source_media_id=parent.id WHERE child.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND child.runtime_session_id=#{runtimeSession} ) SELECT media.id::text AS id,media.session_id AS product_session_id,media.runtime_session_id,media.media_run_id AS run_id, media.source_media_id::text AS source_id,media.media_transform AS transform,media.body_format,media.referenced_at FROM public.nw_chat_session_attachments media JOIN family ON family.id=media.id ORDER BY media.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF media
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nw_chat_session_attachments media SET body_format=NULL,reclaimed_at=clock_timestamp(),name=NULL WHERE media.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND media.session_id=#{productSession} AND media.runtime_session_id=#{runtimeSession} AND media.body_format='bytea.v1' AND media.referenced_at IS NULL AND media.media_run_id IS NULL AND media.id IN CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_chat_session_attachments root WHERE root.tenant_id=media.tenant_id AND root.runtime_session_id=#{runtimeSession} AND root.id=CAST(#{rootId} AS uuid) AND root.session_id=#{productSession} AND root.source_media_id IS NULL AND root.media_transform='source-v1' AND root.created_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '30 days') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_chat_session_attachments retained WHERE retained.tenant_id=media.tenant_id AND retained.runtime_session_id=media.runtime_session_id AND retained.source_media_id=media.id AND retained.body_format IS NOT NULL AND retained.id NOT IN CAST(#{id} AS uuid))
